title: Guided Paddleboarding in Phoenix
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
A minimum weight of 35 lbs is required
We require solo-travelers to pay the minimum of the 2-person price. If you are a solo traveler and would like to be added on to a pre-formed group for this tour, please mention this upon booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready to walk on water! Join us and experience the desert from a thrilling new perspective while on the deck of a paddleboard. Our guided paddleboard tour is a perfect introduction to stand up paddling. A paddleboard is similar to a surf board and allows for a standing/paddling form of on-water recreation and touring. 

On this tour, we learn the basics of launching and landing, techniques for balancing, kneeling and standing, and how to turn and navigate on gentle water. We’ll also have a great opportunity to learn about the amazing ecosystem of a desert lake, and see some of flora and fauna which make this such a unique habitat. 

This tour is appropriate for anyone with good physical fitness, a willingness to learn a new skill, and a modest sense of adventure.
